name: week
title: Curriculum review week
subtitle: Internal review work, not accreditation decisions

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM review_queue ORDER BY review_due,reference

sections.title: Unresolved actions
sections.sql: SELECT v.reference,t.owner,t.note,t.due FROM tasks t JOIN version_register v ON v.id=t.version_id WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY due

sections.title: Learning outcome coverage
sections.sql: SELECT reference,module,code,description,programme_links,assessments FROM mapping_coverage ORDER BY reference,code

sections.title: Programme totals
sections.sql: SELECT reference,credits,module_credits,state FROM version_register ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Records to review
sections.note: Checks cover selected NZQA record requirements and local demo policy only. Academic reviewers assess the substance.
sections.sql: SELECT reference,rule,finding FROM curriculum_findings ORDER BY reference,rule,finding
